newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JCI announces five new directors. [CORRECTED 18:18 GMT]
newsitem.headline: JCI announces five new directors. [CORRECTED 18:18 GMT]

text.p: South African mining house JCI Ltd on Wednesday announced the appointment of five new non-executive directors (company corrects to make clear that the new directors will be non-executive).
Marcel Golding, chairman of Hosken Consolidated Investments and Stephen Koseff, managing director of Investec Bank Ltd, will serve in a non-executive capacity.

Audrey Mokhobo, human resources manager of centralised services at Eskom, Saflife Ltd chairman Larry Nestadt and Louis Nchindo, managing director designate of Debswana and Anglo American Corp of South Africa director, will all be executive members of the board.
The 14 member board also comprises Mzi Khumalo as chairman and chief executive and non-executive directors Reuel Khoza, Mike King, Vaughan Bray, Clem Sunter and Tim Wadeson.
Remaining executive members are director of strategy and corporate affairs Nick Segal, Chris Tayelor and Graham Wanblad.
